name: com.nanora.nanora-unity-mcp
description: Unity Editor MCP server that runs entirely inside the Editor (no Node.js or Python). Streamable HTTP for Codex, SSE for Claude Code and Cursor. Scene editing, C# execution, Playwright-style selectors, input simulation and UI assertions, E2E scenarios, visual regression, performance budgets, and bundled Claude Code workflow skills.

samples.description: A simple 2D shooting game demonstrating MCP-driven development workflow
